selection_reason: Full sessions preserve long-horizon dependencies. Survey covers denominator/scope changes and observed syntax/sampling overhead; BI covers weights, bins and rollback; Water covers fitted models, feature/population changes and repair loops. Selection is fixed before new model runs. These are development tasks previously audited, not an unseen holdout or the complete benchmark.
judge_protocol: Unchanged upstream prompt and frozen LongDS v1 references; score 1 is a pass. Judge new outputs only; retain previous results.
trial_policy: Report first pass separately; two additional full-session repetitions quantify variability and recovery without replacing first-pass scores.
model_cost_target: At most 1.25 times matched persistent DSGym cost while retaining the accuracy gain; also compare to the strongest saved react-entries arm.
comparability_limit: Historical controls ran frozen R3; this revision includes previously unmeasured correctness fixes already present locally plus the new efficiency changes. No isolated causal attribution to one new change. Shared backend/model gateway remains the same; resource scheduling is bounded separately.
